en.topic_title: Spies and silicon chips: Alice Huang’s tangled corporate web
en.topic_summary:
Singapore-based tech group Megaspeed dealt in billions of dollars’ worth of the world’s most advanced AI chips, but its office was an empty shell when AFP visited, its staff seemingly vanished long before claims of espionage landed at their door.



The Singapore office of the data centre company MegaSpeed International. Photo: Taryn/AFP



Megaspeed’s former director Alice Huang was this week outed as an alleged Chinese spy, accused of having an affair with Nvidia co-founder J
